query:
SELECT mo.id, mo.name
                 FROM moods mo
                WHERE EXISTS (
                          SELECT 1 FROM manifestation_moods mm
                          JOIN manifestations m ON m.id = mm.manifestation_id
                         WHERE mm.mood_id = mo.id
                      )
                  AND mo.name ILIKE $1 || '%'
                ORDER BY mo.name ASC
                LIMIT $2
